title: Index-to-composition suppression: ECS, attribution scar and AIO trigger gates
description: These claims hold that suppression happens between the index and the AI synthesis layer: Google search retrieves an entity while AI Overview excludes its sources, which The Excluded Entity names Entity-Level Compositional Suppression. The Attribution Scar records correct attribution unlocked by an undisclosed string, and The Trigger Decision sets predictions on when an overview renders, from format flips to lag ordering, dial steps and pool asymmetry. Unbuilt tests replicate the queries across Bing, Perplexity, ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini, and ASDF proposes measuring whose architecture is running rather than human or AI.

claims.registered_title: Semantic Indexing Probe Protocol v1.0: Mapping General Index and Summarizer Injection Layers
claims.statement:
This protocol maps the relationship between two distinct indexing layers
    that govern content discoverability in AI-augmented search: Layer 1 (General
    Index), which determines whether content EXISTS in search, and Layer 2
    (Summarizer Index), which determines whether content gets INJECTED into
    AI-generated responses. The protocol uses coordinated queries across Google
    and multiple AI summarizers (Perplexity, ChatGPT, Gemini, Grok) to compute
    the delta between layers—revealing the selection criteria that cause content
    to be indexed but not injected. Designed for use by anyone publishing
